label: holos_as_coded

description: Covered/crusted liquid manure CH4. Holos code is consistent with its manual and with IPCC 2006/2019 Table 10.17: cover factors are REDUCTION fractions (crust 0.40, solid cover 0.25 only), applied as remaining = 1 - reduction. The fork difference versus source_correct is only that Holos's covered path is an MCF-free daily VS-consumed tank model (approximated here as uncovered IPCC MCF times remaining). It is not a reduction/retention mix-up. source_correct uses Table 10.17 MCF including liquid-with-crust (the ~40% crust reduction is already in that MCF). holos_as_coded never stacks the IPCC with-crust MCF on the Holos remaining factor.

options.source_correct: IPCC 2006 Vol 4 Ch 10 Table 10.17 p. 10.44/10.52 and IPCC 2019 Table 10.17 (Updated): distinct MCF by system; with-crust MCF already embeds ~40% CH4 reduction vs uncovered
options.holos_as_coded: Holos AnimalResultsServiceBase.cs:967-972 reductionFactor=0.4 (LiquidWithNaturalCrust) else 0.25 (LiquidWithSolidCover only; ManureStateTypeExtensions.cs:53-56). Lines 1279-1283 return manureMethane * (1 - emissionReductionFactor). Remaining 0.60 crust / 0.75 solid cover. Covered path is MCF-free; this fork uses uncovered MCF * remaining and does not apply 0.25 to non-solid covers.

description: Direct soil N2O EF1 is a model-version option, not a bug fork. ipcc2006_ef1 is IPCC 2006 Table 11.1 EF1=0.01. holos_liang2020 is Holos V4 Sec 2.5 / Liang et al. 2020 Nutr. Cycl. Agroecosyst. 117:145-167 DOI 10.1007/s10705-020-10058-w: EF_CT=exp(0.00558*P_or_PE_mm-7.7), times topography (Eq 2.5.2), RF_TX (Table 13; default 1 if unspecified), and winter 1/0.645 (Pelster 2023). Growing-season P and PE (May-October, CanSIS 1980-2010) are required; a P/PE ratio or P/PE=1 clamp is not Holos climate. Rochette 2008 supplies FR_Topo only. Holos C# N2OEmissionFactorCalculator.cs:478-656,777-788 matches the opened Pogue et al. 2025 Sec 2.5 (no holos_as_coded EF1 bug). Missing climate is UNVERIFIED-input; do not report county deltas from an assumed P/PE.

options.ipcc2006_ef1: IPCC 2006 Vol 4 Ch 11 Table 11.1 EF1=0.01 (VERIFIED). Usable without growing-season P/PE.
options.holos_liang2020: Holos V4 Algorithm Document Sec 2.5 (opened Pogue et al. 2025 docx @036f862) and N2OEmissionFactorCalculator.cs:478-656,777-788: Liang 2020 EF_CT=exp(0.00558*moisture_mm-7.7). Humid P/PE>1 uses P; dry uses PE*FR_Topo+P*(1-FR_Topo); irrigated uses PE. Rochette 2008 is FR_Topo only, not Eq 3 EFeco. Requires growing-season P and PE in mm. UNVERIFIED-input without those values.
